description: Réseaux d'eau : Eau potable : Protection incendie : Communes de la CUA, gérées par Eaux de Normandie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Water networks: Drinking water: Fire protection: Communes of the AUC, managed by Eaux de Normandie" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
